get.description: Webhook delivery status: whether the external Webhook is configured (`not_configured` means it is disabled, which is not an error: nothing is delivered and the gate is unaffected), a misconfiguration classification, the destination host only (never userinfo, path, query or the signing secret), delivery counts, the last success/failure times and the most recent delivery records. Delivery guarantees: at-least-once (the same event can arrive more than once after a retry, a crash or an admin retry, so receivers must de-duplicate by the stable event ID), no ordering guarantee, signed with HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp and body. The endpoint and secret are server configuration only and cannot be changed through the API. Delivery runs outside the gate state transition: Webhook failures never change the gate and never create new notification events.

post.description: Requeue failed deliveries so they are sent again with the same event ID (at-least-once: the receiver may see the event more than once). With `event_id`, only that failed delivery is requeued (404 if it is not currently failed); without it, every failed delivery is requeued. Failed deliveries are never retried automatically.

404.description: No failed delivery with that event ID

post.description: Send one synthetic `webhook_test` event (event ID prefixed `test_`) to the configured endpoint through the same path as real deliveries (signature, destination check, timeout) and return the result. The test is a single attempt: it is not retried and no delivery record is stored. It never changes the gate state, the notification list or unread counts. Returns 409 when the Webhook is not configured or misconfigured (nothing is sent).

200.description: Test sent; `delivered` tells whether the receiver answered 2xx

409.description: Webhook is not configured or misconfigured

NOT MOUNTED in production (implemented by D8P; the route is mounted only in tests until P4/D8R, block writes stay unmounted until D8R). Revision: `expected_revision` omitted creates (409 if the control already exists); `expected_revision` = current revision replaces (409 on mismatch, including a control deleted meanwhile). tags.name: ProfileActor
tags.description: Profile ActivityPub actor document (1 Profile = 1 actor). The generation logic exists (P1) but the route is NOT MOUNTED on the production router before the P4 cutover.

tags.name: ProfilePolicy
tags.description: CONTRACT ONLY, not mounted on the production router (mounted in P4 at the earliest): Profile identity, Profile-scoped follow, individual block/mute and domain-controls. Handlers answer 501 until P1/P2/P3o/P3i/D8G/D8R implement them, except domain-controls, which D8P implemented (stored, revision-controlled, owner-only) but which stay unmounted on the production router until P4/D8R. Owner-only authorization, revision conflicts (409) and errors are the contract.

tags.name: RegistrationGate
tags.description: Registration readiness gate control plane (admin only). NOTE: E15a is the control plane only. Until the Kratos enforcement unit (E15d) is connected, opening, closing or overriding the gate does NOT block or allow real Kratos registrations; real registration is not protected yet.

tags.name: RegistrationGateWebhook
tags.description: External Webhook delivery of registration gate notification events (admin only; E15w). The endpoint URL and the HMAC-SHA256 signing secret are server configuration only (REGISTRATION_WEBHOOK_URL, REGISTRATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET or REGISTRATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET_FILE). When they are unset the Webhook is disabled: nothing is delivered, the status endpoint reports `not_configured`, and the gate is unaffected (this is not an error). Delivery guarantees: at-least-once, so the same event can be delivered more than once (retries, crash recovery, admin retry) and receivers must de-duplicate by the stable event ID (`X-Emumet-Event-Id`); ordering is not guaranteed (order by `occurred_at` if needed). Retries: 408/429/5xx/timeouts/connection failures are retried with exponential backoff and jitter (Retry-After is honored up to a cap) until the attempt or age limit, then the delivery is `failed`; redirects, other 4xx responses and destination-check (SSRF) rejections fail immediately. Failed deliveries are resent only when an admin requests a retry. Webhook trouble never changes the gate state and never creates a new notification event. HTTPS only, no redirects, destinations are checked at connect time and pinned. Receiver documentation: docs/registration-gate-webhook.md.
